{{Top|leg}}
'''Ka/La''' was a type of steam-powered [[nuclear fusion]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Girodyne/Legends|Girodyne]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was used as the propulsion system in the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[digger crawler]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|194|Ka/La}}</ref>
